▪ CBR remained at 7% since April
2020, down from 7.25% in
March and 8.25% in January.
▪ Yield curve for Government
securities have started rising in
2021 compared to 2020 average
levels. The 91-days paper (6.8%
to 6.9%), 182-days (7.4% to
7.6%) and 364-days (8.5% to
8.7%).
▪ Inter-bank rate has also risen to
an average of 4.7% YTD from
the average level of 3.7% in
2020.
